title: Managed Database: collection suspension
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database collection suspension applies to database suspend. The contract status is active. Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued. The contract payment restriction is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. Add invoice due days and then suspension grace days UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation. Equality qualifies. The source overdue invoice must retain a positive unpaid principal; a fully paid invoice cannot justify suspension. Earlier handling sends an informational explanation without a status change. An agent suspends active service only when official payment restriction is restricted; ordinary billing disputes alone do not suspend service. Retained ancillary resources can still produce actual supplemental usage. Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

## Evidence: contract state
The contract status is active. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, status. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference. 

## Evidence: collection deadline
Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, invoice issue time. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference. Add invoice due days and then suspension grace days UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation. The comparison uses the current handling clock and includes equality at the boundary.

## Deadline boundary case
Hypothetical boundary case: handling exactly at the source-derived deadline satisfies this time gate; handling immediately before it does not.

## Evidence: collection restriction
The contract payment restriction is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database contract reference, payment restriction, database occurrence reference, amount. The correlated evidence must refer together to database contract reference, database occurrence reference. 

## Specific basis: total collection days
Total collection days: The sum of the tier invoice due days and the tier suspension grace days..
